scope: First-party source checks for this local correction iteration; no source activation or release approval

sources.finding: Ordinary refunds use the contribution payment date; conditional-wage refunds use the repayment due date for those wages. Unrelated loan dates do not establish that date.
Foreign-company changes have a 30-day notification period. A later change cannot establish timeliness of an earlier change.
Ordinary YA retention and post-dissolution retention are separate requirements; both must be considered.
Declared commencement is 20 October 2026, including updated annual-return officer particulars and the additional CEO-role question. This notice does not establish all earlier filing duties.
Paragraphs 1, 2 and 5 establish commencement, population and initial report trigger. Paragraphs 20 and 21 distinguish transition cases, with prior-notice cases preserved by paragraph 21.

The VCFM-specific toolkit was inspected separately. Text searches found no QDC or Quarterly entry; this does not establish a QDC exemption or the precise form. Additional authoritative evidence remains necessary.

additionalSourceChecks.finding: Conditional-wage repayment arises from non-fulfilment of conditions tied to the original payment. Repayment of an ordinary duplicate payroll payment does not by itself establish conditional wages.
Annual-leave eligibility begins at three months, including probation; completed-month pro-rating and approved unpaid-leave exclusions apply.
Graduated outpatient/hospitalisation entitlements are 5/15, 8/30, 11/45 and 14/60 at three, four, five and at least six months. Hospitalisation limits include outpatient leave.
